textRuns.value: Method and limits. Coefficients come from an OLS regression of daily Nifty returns on daily Brent returns, daily USD/INR change, daily FII flow and an event-severity dummy (notebooks/03_oil_flows_returns_regression.ipynb, n=115 trading days, R2=0.176). Only two drivers were significant: Brent return -0.0774 (p=0.001) and USD/INR change -0.4228 (p=0.018). Those two drive this grid. FII flow (p=0.424) and the severity dummy (p=0.353) were not significant and are deliberately excluded. There is no projected FII band or CAD impact here because neither has a supporting model. The lab is NOT keyed on Hormuz lost-bpd: that relationship was tested across six specifications (levels, first differences, lagged, and forward 5-day) and was null in every one, with correlations of -0.09 and 0.02; lost-bpd is an analyst intensity estimate tied to the 0-4 status ladder rather than a measured quantity. This is an explanatory model on historical data, not a predictive one.
